package.name: cloud_object_detector
package.description: 3D detection front-end of the 3D perception pipeline: /points_self_filtered → Euclidean clustering → convex footprint + height (Shape POLYGON) → autoware_perception_msgs/DetectedObjects for autoware_multi_object_tracker. Stateless per cloud — association and velocity estimation belong to the tracker. HUMBLE-ONLY (like the rest of the 3D stack): not part of the Foxy build set.
